description: A large ornate concert hall with painted arched ceilings, chandeliers and a pipe organ on the right wall. A conductor in a black tailcoat stands on a raised platform, arm raised with a baton, in front of a seated orchestra with music stands. Potted palms and flowers line the platform. In the foreground, men in top hats, bowler hats and dark suits and women in long Victorian dresses stand and talk on the open floor, with a small fountain pool of ferns in the lower right. A balcony crowd is visible at upper left. Smoke or haze hangs in the air.
